_comment: FINITE-MANA (real gearing) stat weights for the reference Arcane setup, computed by wowsims finite-difference on a mana-managed CONSERVE rotation (tools/genconserve.mjs). This is the REAL gearing EP (docs/EP.md), distinct from the infinite-mana LAYOUT ceiling (tests/ep-model.mjs / ep-sim.sh). Reproduce: source scratchpad env, then `node tests/ep-finite.mjs --dur 300 --iter 45000 --seed 11 --inf` (and `--native`, and `--dur 145/420`). All EP normalized to SpellPower=1.

method.route: wowsims finite-difference (docs/PLAN.md option B), central diff, var0, CRN-desynced so relies on large N
method.rotation: conserve: AB-spam in burn windows (BL/AP/IV up), Frostbolt filler below a mana threshold, Evocation deep-low, autocastOtherCooldowns fires Innervate+ManaTide (tools/genconserve.mjs)
method.mana_sources_modeled: wowsims engine on the real export: regen (mana-spring mp5 + ShadowPriest/Vampiric-Touch +250 mp5 + spirit*sqrt(int)*0.30 casting), JoW 74/hit, ManaTide 6%/tick x4, Innervate (5x spirit, ForceFullSpiritRegen), Evocation 15%x4, Mana-Emerald gem. Molten Armor (not Mage Armor).
method.gear: reference Arcane raid export, 13376 mana pool, ~38% crit, Molten Armor, full raid buffs

300s_native_realMana.note: cross-check: export's OWN wowsims Arcane rotation; agrees with conserve

300s_conserve_infiniteMana.note: the LAYOUT ceiling on the SAME schedule: haste inflated, regen=0, int=throughput-only (0.557 matches the EP.md closed form 0.29+0.317*0.689)

420s_intermission60s.note: 60s downtime: dilutes haste (less casting), boosts regen (bank-and-burst)

haste_vs_fightlength_abs._comment: absolute DPS per haste-rating (conserve, real mana): haste is MOST valuable on SHORT fights in raw DPS; the EP ratio inverts only because SP scales even harder

value_of_mana_analytic.derivation: (DPS_AB_3stack 2242 - DPS_FB 1404) / (drain_AB 458 - drain_FB 79 mana/s, JoW-adjusted) at the conserve margin
value_of_mana_analytic.MP5_EP_derived: 0.49-0.55 (0.2 mana/s * 2.21 / SP_weight) -> brackets the sim's 0.66 (docs/PLAN.md option C, tests/mana-value.mjs)

trust_anchors.conserve_vs_native_DPS: 1916 vs 1969 (-2.7%) — the simple threshold controller reproduces wowsims' own Arcane rotation
trust_anchors.pure_OOM_haste_EP: 0.03 — the naive AB-spam-until-OOM-then-idle rotation (the 'haste is weak' folklore case); conserve play recovers haste to ~0.96
trust_anchors.infinite_int_vs_closedform: 0.557 measured vs 0.51 EP.md closed form (0.29*SP + 0.317*crit) — validates the harness against the model route

ordering_realGearing: SP ~= Int > Haste > Crit > MP5 > Spirit >> Mana  (300s single-target; short fights push haste down in EP terms, intermissions push regen up)
